body.name: Finite uniform protocol-slice record \(R\)
body.construction: A record is \(R=(b_S,b_{\ell},b_J,b_T,(\tau_j)_{j\in J})\), where \(b_S\in\{0,1\}^{|\mathcal A|}\) is a protocol mask, \(b_{\ell}\in\{0,1\}^{|\mathrm{LIT}|}\) is its slice label, \(b_J\in\{0,1\}^{k}\) owns target factors, and \(b_T\in\{0,1\}^{V\sqcup(V\times\mathrm{LIT})}\) records the labelled single-district source factor extracted from that slice. Its fixed-width part has \(|\mathcal A|+|\mathrm{LIT}|+k+|V|(1+|\mathrm{LIT}|)\) bits, followed by self-delimiting encodings of one transcript schema per owned factor.
